kind: correctness validation; not a performance benchmark

numeric_contracts.alpha: exact bits, including NaN payload and negative zero

findings: Integer lookup/fixed-point paths lose float precision; native JXL P3 comparison first failed its frozen 0.0001 limit.
Merely disabling fixed-point did not pass the native limit; analytic float curves are used when available.
Bounded execution retains source and destination color clipping without clamping alpha; a bounded staging buffer covers out-of-range rows.
Embedded CICP must not override explicitly selected ICC curves.
A gamma-2 blue channel with matching gamma-1 red/green produced 0.2499466 instead of 0.0625. Profiles affected by partial curve sharing now refuse before executor construction.
MoxCmsError implements core::error::Error and remains inspectable through whereat and CmsPluginError.
forbid_lossy() still sets clip_out_of_gamut=true; request false explicitly for extended float layers.
validation: Convert library: 464 passed, 0 failed, 1 inherited ignored test unchanged.
New and existing CMS integration controls: 19 passed on moxcms 0.8.1 and 0.9.1; 18 passed on 0.9.0 before the final added-alpha control.
Strict lint, no-default-features WASM check and public API snapshot generation pass.
failures_retained: Initial unequal-curve control exposed wrong arithmetic; corrected behavior is explicit typed refusal, not pretending conversion support.
Typed error preservation initially failed to compile because MoxCmsError lacked Error; the trait implementation is now included.
Clipped closed-form control failed at 0.24988556 versus 0.25; bounded float execution was corrected without relaxing its tolerance.
limits: Not general ICC conformance. Arbitrary LUT extended range and all distinct per-channel curves remain unqualified.
No isolated speed, allocation-count or CMS-workspace memory measurement. run-heavy RSS is for the complete command tree.
Native JXL independent Little CMS receipts and pinned full-matrix validation belong to the zencodec consumer.
